name: WIT Studio
description: Known for fluid action animation. Subsidiary of IG Port. Created the first three seasons of Attack on Titan before MAPPA took over the Final Season.
style: Dynamic action sequences, detailed character designs, cinematic direction

name: MAPPA
description: Maruyama Animation Produce Project Association. Studio behind Attack on Titan Final Season, Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man. Known for high-quality action and diverse portfolio.
style: Bold cinematography, fluid action, rich color palettes, experimental direction

name: Ufotable
description: Renowned for blending 2D animation with 3D CG backgrounds. Their work on Demon Slayer set a new industry standard for TV anime visual quality with breathtaking sword-fight sequences.
style: Digital compositing mastery, dynamic 3D camera movement, particle effects, cinematic lighting

name: Kyoto Animation
description: KyoAni. Beloved studio famous for stunning visual quality and deeply emotional storytelling. Known for Clannad, Violet Evergarden, K-On!, Hibike! Euphonium, and A Silent Voice.
style: Luminous backgrounds, expressive character animation, subtle emotional nuances, attention to body language

name: Bones
description: Studio Bones, founded by former Sunrise staff. Known for Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, Mob Psycho 100, My Hero Academia. Consistently produces high-quality action animation.
style: Expressive line work, dynamic fight choreography, bold color design, creative visual metaphors

name: Madhouse
description: Legendary studio behind Hunter x Hunter, Death Note, One Punch Man, Frieren. Known for taking creative risks and producing some of the most critically acclaimed anime.
style: Versatile styles, strong directorial voices, atmospheric storytelling, pioneer in digital-animation hybrid

name: A-1 Pictures
description: Aniplex subsidiary. Massive output studio behind Sword Art Online, Your Lie in April, Kaguya-sama, 86 Eighty-Six. Balances commercial hits with artistic projects.
style: Polished commercial aesthetic, versatile across genres, strong compositing

name: Trigger
description: Founded by ex-Gainax staff. Known for over-the-top action, bold art styles, and rebellious spirit. Behind Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, Kill la Kill, Little Witch Academia, Promare.
style: Exaggerated poses, bold geometric shapes, hyper-kinetic action, vibrant color explosions

name: Shaft
description: Known for avant-garde visual style under director Akiyuki Shinbo. Behind the Monogatari series, Madoka Magica, March Comes In Like a Lion. Signature head tilts and abstract backgrounds.
style: Abstract compositions, extreme close-ups, typography-as-art, surreal architectural spaces, color-coded scenes

name: CloverWorks
description: Spin-off from A-1 Pictures. Quickly established itself with hits like Bocchi the Rock!, Spy x Family (co-production), Horimiya, and The Promised Neverland S1. Known for creative visual storytelling.
style: Expressive character acting, creative visual metaphors, polished modern aesthetic, bold color choices

name: Sunrise
description: Bandai Namco subsidiary. Home of Gundam, Code Geass, Cowboy Bebop, Love Live! franchise. The defining studio for mecha anime with decades of industry leadership.
style: Clean mechanical design, dynamic mecha combat, strong character designs, polished production values

name: Production I.G
description: Behind Ghost in the Shell, Psycho-Pass, Haikyuu!!, and many prestige projects. Known for detailed, realistic art and intelligent sci-fi storytelling.
style: Realistic character proportions, detailed backgrounds, cinematic shot composition, sophisticated sci-fi aesthetic

name: White Fox
description: Studio behind Steins;Gate, Re:Zero, and Katanagatari. Specializes in adapting visual novels and light novels with careful attention to source material.
style: Faithful adaptation approach, strong character animation, atmospheric color design, careful pacing

name: Gainax
description: Legendary but now-defunct studio behind Evangelion, Gurren Lagann, FLCL. Revolutionized anime with experimental direction and psychological depth. Its legacy lives on through Trigger and Khara.
style: Experimental direction, bold animation set pieces, psychological imagery, genre-deconstructing storytelling

name: Toei Animation
description: One of the oldest and largest anime studios. Produces One Piece, Dragon Ball, Pretty Cure, Sailor Moon. Massive output spanning decades of iconic shounen and magical girl series.
style: Classic shounen aesthetic, iconic transformation sequences, long-running series expertise, bold linework
